basic_details.short_information: Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak (MDU Rohtak) Field Investigator Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of Maharshi Dayanand University, Rohtak (MDU Rohtak). A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the MDU Rohtak Field Investigator Recruitment 2026.

qualification.details: Post Graduate in any relevant discipline with a minimum 55% marks. A 5% relaxation is allowed to SC/ST or persons with disabilities as per M. D. University Rohtak rules.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MDU Rohtak Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-07-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MDU Rohtak Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Field Investigator post is 31st July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in any relevant discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. A relaxation of 5% is provided for SC/ST and PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Field Investigator.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job is located in Rohtak, Haryana.

faq.question: Q9. When is the tentative date for the interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the interview is 5th August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job.
